Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Location: Remote. Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain).

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with over 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We are an AI technology solutions provider for major technology companies and leaders across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of digital data solutions and high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
Overview

Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Business Analyst to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of data systems such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS / LIS), Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), etc., and Artificial Intelligence projects. As part of our partner’s Software Data Engineering and Business Intelligence team, you will collaborate with software developers to build systems tailored to the needs of scientists, professionals, and engineers involved in R&D, Manufacturing, and other workflows.

Monthly salary : $2,000 - $3,000

  • Gather business requirements from scientists, engineers, and other stakeholders.

  • Utilize JIRA to track and prioritize tasks and deliverables.

Required qualifications

  • Native / Bilingual English is required for this role (read / written / spoken).
  • 3+ years of Business Analyst experience in the biotech industry.
  • 1+ years of experience working with scientific data systems such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), etc.
  • Excellent English communication skills around technical and non-technical topics.
  • Experience with Project Management / planning tools, such as JIRA.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Biotechnology, Life Science, Chemistry, or equivalent.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products : Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Smartsheet.
  • Must maintain a high level of ownership and see assignments through to completion based on agreed-upon deadlines.
  • Must be highly organized, independently driven, results-oriented, and a quick learner.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Life Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or equivalent.
  • 1+ years of experience working with dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire.
  • Experience with validated, 21 CFR Part 11 compliant computer systems or a GxP environment.
  • Hands-on experience with database design and querying languages like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar.
  • Broad understanding of, and experience with, various hardware and software systems, including their installation, maintenance, and lifecycles.
  • Familiarity with ISO : 9001 compliance in a production environment.

Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work with a fast-growing company, driving digital transformation across enterprise IT infrastructure and operations.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

Work Schedule : Eastern Standard Time

Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

  • Atuação anterior em ambientes financeiros, com compliance (LGPD, Open Finance, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001).

Diferenciais Desejados

  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, Security Specialty).
  • Experiência com arquitetura hexagonal, DDD, event sourcing.
  • Background em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT, Cognito, OpenID Connect) e integração com Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping).

Overview

Company Cox Automotive - USA

Job Family Group Sales

Job Profile Operations Performance Manager - CAI

The salary rate may vary within the anticipated range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate\'s experience. In addition to the salary range identified herein, this role is also eligible for an annual incentive/commission target of $42,300.00.

Job Description

The Cox Automotive Fixed Operations Performance Manager plays a critical role in driving value and retention across the Dealer Solutions portfolio—including F&I, DMS, and Xtime Service products—for franchise and large independent automotive dealers. This role is designed for professionals with deep retail automotive experience , especially in fixed operations , who can translate dealership challenges into actionable solutions using Cox Automotive’s suite of technologies.

This position is ideal for someone who has managed or worked extensively within dealership service departments , understands the nuances of dealership operations, and can serve as a trusted advisor to clients. The Operations Performance Manager is the primary point of contact for Dealertrack and Xtime solutions and is responsible for maximizing product utilization, improving dealership performance, and driving organic growth.

This is a regional position and we are accepting applicants from the Pacific, Mountain, and select Central time zones .

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner to automotive dealerships, leveraging your hands-on dealership experience to drive adoption and performance of Cox Automotive solutions.
  • Evaluate dealership operations and align product usage with dealer goals, focusing on efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction .
  • Establish a regular cadence of in-store and virtual engagements to assess performance, identify gaps, and implement process improvements.
  • Apply your fixed ops expertise to optimize service lane operations using Xtime and related tools.
  • Identify upsell opportunities by understanding dealership pain points and recommending relevant solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with sales and product teams to ensure seamless integration of new offerings into dealership workflows.
  • Proactively manage at-risk accounts using a consultative, data-driven approach to retain and grow relationships.
  • Stay current on product updates and enhancements and communicate their value in the context of dealership operations.

What’s In It For You?

Here’s a sneak peek of the benefits you could experience as a Cox employee:

  • A competitive salary and top-notch bonus/incentive plans.
  • A pro-sales culture that honors what salespeople (like you!) contribute to our success.
  • Exceptional work-life balance, flexible time-off policies and accommodating work schedules.
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits, with multiple options for individuals and families.
  • Generous 401(k) retirement plans with company match.
  • Inclusive parental leave policies, plus comprehensive fertility coverage and adoption assistance.
  • Professional development and continuing education opportunities.
  • Access to financial wellness/planning resources.

Who You Are

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Safe drivers needed; valid driver\'s license required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years managing a fixed operations department or equivalent experience in a retail automotive dealership.
  • Deep understanding of dealership operations, including service, parts, and F&I.
  • Proven ability to influence dealership personnel at all levels—from service advisors to general managers.
  • Proficient in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and virtual collaboration tools.
  • Strong communication and listening skills, with the ability to uncover operational challenges and propose impactful solutions.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating cross-functionally.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. Cox provides reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with disability, unless such accommodations would cause an undue hardship. Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship.In California and Washington, we will consider non-driving candidates who use alternate means of transportation in accordance with applicable law.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).   • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG. Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos. O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.

  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.
  • Levanta e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.

  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.
  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado).
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.

  • Programação no Power BI.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

Se você busca um alto potencial de remuneração e deseja atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital.

Você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental, ou seja, alinhar o conhecimento técnico e as formas de tratativa com os clientes, para que eles compreendam as estratégias e como elas se encaixam.

Essa vaga é direcionada a planejadores e assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil a ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13 / 10 / 25 :

O Grupo Capital :

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam batermetas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l :

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos / soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro / Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial

Você terá

  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;

  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos / produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;

title: Supply Chain Manager | Fast Growth Ecommerce Brand
description:
Overview

Supply Chain Manager — Build the Backbone of a Global Lifestyle Brand

About Holme & Hadfield

We’re not just a DTC brand — we’re a movement. At Holme & Hadfield, we design premium organizers that help collectors showcase their passions and preserve what matters. In just 4 years, we’ve grown to $7M in annual revenue, with customers in the US, Canada, Europe, and Asia.

Our next move? 4X growth in the next five years. And to do that, we need a supply chain that scales with precision, agility, and strategic oversight. That’s where you come in.

The Role

As Supply Chain Manager, you’ll lead the strategy and execution that keeps our products flowing — from factory to doorstep. You’ll have end-to-end ownership over global inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, and supplier relationships.

This isn’t a behind-the-scenes role. It’s mission-critical. You’ll ensure customers around the world get our products on time, at the right cost, and with a frictionless experience that builds loyalty.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Inventory That Works for Us — Not Against Us

  • Manage global inventory levels across Shopify, Amazon, and 3PLs
  • Own demand forecasting — leveraging sales history, seasonality, and launches
  • Prevent overstock and stockouts through data-driven planning

Fulfillment That Scales with Growth

  • Optimize our order flow from purchase order to delivery across all markets
  • Coordinate with 3PLs, Amazon FBA, and warehouses to maintain SLA performance
  • Ensure seamless restocks and product transfers across regions

Supplier & Logistics Leadership

  • Build and maintain strong supplier relationships — proactively managing lead times, quality, and cost
  • Oversee freight and logistics operations (freight forwarders, customs, tariffs, etc.)
  • Negotiate timelines and payment terms that balance speed with capital efficiency

Visibility, Dashboards, and Decision Support

  • Develop internal dashboards that show real-time inventory and supply chain health
  • Track KPIs: inventory turnover, fulfillment times, landed cost, aging inventory, etc.
  • Share actionable insights with leadership to inform purchasing, pricing, and promo strategy

Strategic Initiatives & Cost Optimization

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities across shipping, warehousing, and procurement
  • Partner with Finance to align purchasing with cash flow and profitability goals
  • Support Marketing with inventory-driven campaign recommendations

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves :

  • 5+ years of supply chain experience, ideally in ecommerce or D2C
  • Deep familiarity with Amazon FBA, Shopify, and global fulfillment networks
  • Proven ability to manage end-to-end logistics — from POs to last-mile delivery
  • Strong Excel / data skills — you know your way around a pivot table and a demand model
  • Experience managing freight, customs, and multi-region inventory flows

Bonus Points :

  • Experience with high-growth consumer product brands
  • Prior work in multi-market fulfillment (US, Canada, EU, Asia)
  • Familiarity with tools like Inventory Planner, NetSuite, Airtable, or similar
  • Background in cost accounting or experience working closely with Finance

Personal Traits :

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable owning processes end-to-end
  • Strategic thinker who can balance short-term action with long-term planning
  • Clear communicator who thrives in cross-functional collaboration
  • Calm under pressure and comfortable with complexity

Why Join Us?

Meaningful Product – Help collectors preserve what matters most

End-to-End Ownership – You’re not just managing tasks — you’re building systems

Global Scope – Work across continents and time zones

Real Growth – 4X plans = real opportunity for growth, impact, and challenge

Agility & Speed – Work in a startup with a track record of making bold moves

Clarity in KPIs – Your impact will be measurable, visible, and celebrated

Ready to Build Something Bigger Than a Supply Chain?

If you’re a builder, optimizer, and strategic operator — and love the idea of helping a brand scale smart, not just fast — we want to hear from you. Come be the architect of our operational future.

Apply now. Let’s build the backbone that drives the next chapter of Holme & Hadfield.

Holme & Hadfield is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Overview

About the Role

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines

Nice to Have Skills

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

title: Sdr Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Overview

Descrição: SDR Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative) dinâmico, proativo e especialista em prospecção B2B para integrar nosso time, com foco no mercado dos Estados Unidos. Este profissional será a força motriz por trás da expansão do nosso projeto SaaS.

Responsibilities

  • Configurar e otimizar campanhas de prospecção e conexão com leads dentro do ICP (Ideal Customer Profile), utilizando ferramentas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dux, etc.
  • Identificar dores, desafios e oportunidades dos leads que possam ser solucionados pela nossa empresa, para personalizar a abordagem de vendas.
  • Realizar pesquisa e análise prévia do perfil da empresa a ser contatada, bem como dos decisores (decision-makers) que serão convidados para a demonstração.
  • Qualificar leads de forma estratégica, utilizando técnicas de pesquisa para garantir que apenas as oportunidades mais promissoras avancem no funil de vendas.
  • Efetuar cold calls e buscar contatos via redes sociais corporativas, visando agendar o maior número de demonstrações qualificadas possíveis.
  • Enviar mensagens personalizadas no LinkedIn e e-mails para leads qualificados, com o objetivo de gerar conexão, educar o mercado e despertar interesse no produto.
  • Realizar follow-ups constantes para nutrir o relacionamento com potenciais clientes, criando um cenário favorável para a conversão após a demonstração.
  • Manter o CRM (Hubspot) e outras planilhas internas meticulosamente atualizadas, registrando todas as interações e o progresso dos leads.
  • Gerir ativamente a agenda de demonstrações, incluindo marcação, confirmação e reagendamentos, atuando sempre com atenção e proatividade.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas (Closers) para garantir que as reuniões agendadas sejam altamente produtivas, fornecendo todo o contexto necessário sobre o lead.
  • Cumprir rigorosamente os prazos e metas estabelecidos pela gestão.

Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente é importante e requisito, pois toda a comunicação (ligações, e-mails) será em inglês.
  • Cursando ou formado em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em prospecção e cold calls.
  • Experiência prévia na qualificação de leads.
  • Experiência como SDR prospectando para produtos SaaS (Software as a Service) ou de tecnologia.
  • Boa capacidade de gerir múltiplas tarefas e cumprir prazos em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita na língua portuguesa e inglesa.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática, como MS Office, softwares de CRM (Hubspot é um diferencial), redes sociais e agendas eletrônicas.
  • Experiência e desenvoltura em reuniões remotas via Teams, Google Meet, etc.

Diferenciais

  • Já ter atuado com segmentação e qualificação de leads em mercados como startups, empresas de tecnologia e marcas inovadoras.
  • Experiência com metodologias de vendas como SPIN Selling, MEDDIC, ou The Challenger Sale.
  • Conhecimento de PNL (Programação Neurolinguística) aplicada a vendas.
  • Cursos e certificações em Vendas, Inbound Marketing ou Customer Success.

Competências Importantes

  • Comunicação, habilidade em negociação, poder de persuasão e carisma.
  • Perfil empreendedor, resiliente e orientado para resultados.
  • Capacidade de contornar objeções e lidar com frustrações.
  • Ambição voltada para o crescimento profissional e financeiro.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, sob pressão e com metas.
  • Capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks de forma construtiva.

Informações sobre a Contratação

  • Contrato: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)
  • Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto (home office)
  • Remuneração: Fixo + Remuneração variável sobre reunião qualificada.
